_about: PS2 Radar (ps2radar.com) second opinion for build-log review lists, written by scripts/radar-lookup.mjs (radar.mjs). Keyed by slug. stored=false = 404 not stored. Optional: only build-log reads this file (link, badge, sort hint); a Radar mark never hides or flags anyone. If the API fails or disappears, unavailableSince is set and the cached answers stay as a record.
